answer: Each bonded identity that equivocates is attributable through signed conflicting messages. When k identities coordinate, correlated evidence scales the base slash as O(k²), not as k unrelated incidents. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, exp(αk), to the operator’s linked escrow, so splitting stake across a sybil swarm worsens exposure rather than hiding it. Like cedar roots binding a terrace against tundra winds, shared control leaves structure to detect.
